$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Now Playing player settings; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: nowPlaying
lists.note: The Now Playing player (Austin's idea, Leo 2026-10-18): off by default since 2026-10-19 (Lawrence did not want the card in the sidebar); the user can turn it on. Only cmux's own tabs and player feed it unless sidebar.nowPlaying.otherApps is on (Lawrence 2026-10-21: it showed his other browser's audio).

rows.note: Off by default. Off: no Now Playing card in the sidebar; a tab playing sound shows only its speaker in the tab strip. The New Tab page's player is tabs.newTabNowPlaying.

help.text: A player for what is playing, at the bottom of the sidebar.

rows.note: Off by default (Lawrence 2026-10-21). Off: the sidebar card and the New Tab player show only what plays in cmux (its browser tabs and its player), and macOS Now Playing is not read. On: another app that plays (Spotify, Music, another browser) shows too.

title.text: Include Other Apps in Now Playing

help.text: Also show what plays in other apps, such as Spotify, Music or another browser. Off: only what plays in cmux.

lists.name: newTab
lists.note: The New Tab page's Now Playing player (Leo 2026-10-19: "disableable"): off by default since 2026-10-21 (Lawrence: "get rid of music player thing by default"); its right-click menu's Hide Now Playing turns it off.

rows.name: newTab
rows.note: Off by default since 2026-10-21 (Lawrence), as the sidebar card (sidebar.nowPlaying.enabled) is. Off: no player on the New Tab page and no space kept for it. A cmux.json without the key gets the new default; a true written by the user stays.

title.text: Show Now Playing on New Tab

help.text: A player for what is playing, on the New Tab page.

lists.name: pictureInPicture
lists.note: cmux's own Picture in Picture entry points for a web page's video: on by default (today's behavior).

rows.name: pictureInPicture
rows.note: On by default. Off: cmux offers no Picture in Picture of its own: the tab and media card menus, the palette, the CLI and MCP action, the Now Playing card's button and the media hub's button are gone. A site's own video controls are unchanged.

help.text: Offer Picture in Picture for a web page's video in menus, the command palette and the media controls. A site's own video controls are not affected.
